(set-logic ALL)
(declare-const _tmp_call_0 Bool)
(declare-const _tmp_call_0_active Int)
(declare-const _tmp_call_0_id Int)
(assert (= _tmp_call_0_id 7))
(assert (= _tmp_call_0_active true))
(assert (= _tmp_call_0 (and _tmp_call_0_active (> _tmp_call_0_id 0))))
(assert (not _tmp_call_0))
(check-sat)
; unsat means proved

(set-logic ALL)
(assert (not (= true true)))
